# Clarity skills

> Agent skills for Clarity smart contracts on Stacks: development, security and auditing, testing and fuzzing, deployment, upgrades, governance, costs, protocol integrations (sBTC, Zest, Granite, Bitflow, Hermetica, Pyth), Bitcoin proofs and SIP compliance. Each skill is a SKILL.md folder following the Agent Skills format; install the whole set, since skills link to each other.

Start with `clarity:start`: it names the skills to load for a task.

## Router

- [clarity:start](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/start/SKILL.md): Start here for any Clarity (.clar) or Stacks smart-contract task: contracts, tokens, vaults, DeFi, tests, deployment, audits, sBTC or protocol integration, and questions about Clarity behavior, versions or addresses. Writing or changing a contract also needs clarity:scholar and clarity:security; this skill names the rest.

## Skills

- [clarity:apis](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/apis/SKILL.md): Read Stacks chain data off-chain: Hiro and node APIs, transactions, contract events, balances, read-only calls, sBTC deposit and withdrawal history. Use for scripts, indexers, bots or exports that query Stacks data.
- [clarity:assets](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/assets/SKILL.md): Handle assets in Clarity: STX, SIP-010 tokens, SIP-009 NFTs, sBTC (available vs locked), custody, transfers, burns and post-conditions. Use whenever a contract moves, holds or accounts for tokens.
- [clarity:auditor](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/auditor/SKILL.md): Audit or security-review Clarity contracts: threat model, Clarity-specific checks, simnet PoC exploits, severity and findings. Use for any request to review, audit or find issues in .clar code.
- [clarity:bitcoin-proofs](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/bitcoin-proofs/SKILL.md): Verify Bitcoin transactions from Clarity: transaction parsing, Merkle proofs (clarity-bitcoin, Clarity 6 natives), BTC payment checks, replay protection, sBTC settlement. Use when a contract must react to a Bitcoin payment.
- [clarity:deployment](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/deployment/SKILL.md): Deploy Clarity contracts to testnet or mainnet: Clarinet deployment plans, scripted releases, initialization calls, nonces and post-deploy checks. Use to deploy, publish or initialize contracts.
- [clarity:ecosystem](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/ecosystem/SKILL.md): Compose one Clarity contract across Stacks protocols: flash loan, liquidation and swap flows, vault strategies into Zest, Granite or Hermetica, atomicity. Use when a contract calls two or more protocols.
- [clarity:environments](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/environments/SKILL.md): Why Clarity behaves differently in simnet, devnet, testnet and mainnet: costs, limits, epochs, boot contracts, forks. Use when something works in one environment but not another, or to pick where to test.
- [clarity:epochs](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/epochs/SKILL.md): Clarity versions and Stacks epochs: which version to target, names added or removed (as-contract, block-height, at-block), behavior changes. Use when a keyword fails to compile or to ask when something changed.
- [clarity:fuzzing](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/fuzzing/SKILL.md): Fuzz Clarity contracts with Rendezvous: invariants, property tests and counterexample replay. Use to fuzz a Clarinet project or add invariants or property tests.
- [clarity:governance](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/governance/SKILL.md): Governance and admin control for Clarity protocols on Stacks: DAO proposals, multisigs, timelocks and 2-step ownership. Use for DAOs, proposals, multisigs, admin roles or owner transfer.
- [clarity:optimizer](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/optimizer/SKILL.md): Cut Clarity execution costs: cost dimensions, block and tenure budgets, Clarinet cost reports and safe rewrites. Use when a transaction is too expensive or hits a block limit.
- [clarity:oracles](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/oracles/SKILL.md): Read prices in Clarity: Pyth Lazer signed feeds, DIA, staleness and confidence checks, test fixtures, migrating from Pyth Core. Use for any price feed or oracle.
- [clarity:protocols](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/protocols/SKILL.md): Verified Stacks DeFi addresses and exact function signatures: Zest, Granite, Bitflow, Stacks Swap, Hermetica, Stacking DAO, ALEX, Velar, USDCx, sBTC, Pyth. Use to call a protocol: loans, swaps, liquidations, deposits.
- [clarity:scholar](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/scholar/SKILL.md): Write, build or refactor Clarity (.clar) contracts: syntax, types, responses, errors, traits, loops and layout. Use before writing or editing Clarity code, fixing compile errors, or answering how Clarity code behaves: what an expression returns, what aborts or rolls back, what the VM checks.
- [clarity:security](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/security/SKILL.md): Load with clarity:scholar when writing or changing a contract that holds funds or has admin roles. Covers tx-sender vs contract-caller, as-contract? allowances, trait validation, signatures, arithmetic and rollback. Use for access control, custody or fixing a vulnerability.
- [clarity:sip-compliance](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/sip-compliance/SKILL.md): Token standards in Clarity: SIP-010, SIP-009 and SIP-013 traits and conformance, metadata, SIP-018 signed data. Use when writing a token or NFT contract or checking trait conformance.
- [clarity:staking](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/staking/SKILL.md): Stack STX through PoX from Clarity: stake and unstake, signers, reward cycles, delegation, with-staking/with-pox allowances, liquid staking (stSTX). Use for contracts or tools that stake STX.
- [clarity:system-integration](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/system-integration/SKILL.md): Stacks system facts: boot contract and SIP trait addresses (pox-5, sip-010-trait) on mainnet and testnet, address versions, transactions, blocks and tenures. Use for standard Stacks addresses or chain mechanics.
- [clarity:testing](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/testing/SKILL.md): Test Clarity contracts with Clarigen and the Clarinet SDK (vitest, simnet): setup, typed calls, mining blocks, coverage, mainnet forks, attacker contracts. Use whenever adding or fixing tests in a Clarinet project.
- [clarity:upgrades](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/upgrades/SKILL.md): Make a Clarity protocol upgradable or migrate a deployed one: stable custody with replaceable logic, registries, timelocked cutovers, state migration. Use for upgrades, v2 logic, proxies or migrations.
- [clarity:wallets](https://github.com/cybasecurity/clarity-skills/blob/main/plugin/skills/wallets/SKILL.md): Connect Stacks wallets (Leather, Xverse, Ledger) and call contracts from apps with @stacks/connect: contract calls, post-conditions, message signing. Use for frontend or dapp wallet integration.

## Optional
